environment.counter_method: slope between N and N/2 requests
environment.comparison: interleaved scratch packages; the working tree was never rewound
environment.note: Wall time and IPC were diagnostic only because frequency was not pinned.

post_policy_map.interpretation: The former middleware tape is gone from the native path. Actual CSRF token/cookie production and emitted policy headers now dominate the configured-policy increment.

cumulative_policy.finding: CSRF's 18.7k step is token generation plus a 197-byte Set-Cookie result, not dispatcher interaction.

host_count_fusion.implementation: Count Host while lowercasing validated parser spans; delete the second full header walk and the impossible post-parser count check.

prepared_response.implementation: Exact PreparedResponse bypasses the general coercion ladder and uses the native one-shot response ABI; portable ASGI replay is unchanged.

startup_proven_public_dispatch.implementation: The startup compiler assigns any application with protected routes to an authenticated dispatcher, so the public dispatcher no longer rechecks auth-handler membership after every match.

prepared_response_with_native_policy.implementation: Clone immutable PreparedResponse header tuples into an owned list only when native policy needs to transform them, then use the native one-shot instead of replaying ASGI messages.

static_control.interpretation: The three-header request is near the A/A floor; the gain scales with headers no longer revisited.

request_framing_fusion.cycles_and_latency: At a warmed 4.54 GHz the twenty-header bracket was 11967/11925/12062 cycles and 3161/2777/2786 ns, but the first baseline crossed a clock transition. Only instructions are attributed.
request_framing_fusion.implementation: Resolve Host cardinality, Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding, Expect, Connection and Upgrade while validated parser spans are hot; delete decide_framing's second HeaderBlock traversal.

cachegrind_slope.note: High-minus-half slopes, baseline/candidate/baseline. Local predicted mispredicts remained inside baseline A/A; whole-program miss totals moved with code layout and are not attributed.

default_response_wire.implementation: Refresh configured Server and Date fields into one stable bytearray once per second, then copy that contiguous wire block under a free-threading critical section. Explicit application overrides retain the pair-wise fallback.

immutable_response_header_cache.cycles_and_ipc: The reverse bracket put both candidate cycle slopes below baseline (9226/9726/8932; IPC 2.46/2.40/2.55), but its endpoint clock changed, so this remains diagnostic rather than an attributed IPC win.
immutable_response_header_cache.implementation: A connection retains one exact immutable tuple and at most 1024 bytes of validated/lowercased application-header wire. Reuse bypasses sequence conversion, validation, content-length parsing and fragmented appends; mutable and policy-owned lists never enter the cache.
